skills.name: Drifting Vortex
skills.description: Create an Ice Vortex that continuously moves around the battlefield while targeting enemy Deity units (excluding minions) for 8 seconds. While active, the Ice Vortex deals 36% ATK as DMG to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds. If it passes through an enemy that is Crowd Controlled, it instead deals 60% ATK as DMG.

upgrades.level2: While active, the Ice Vortex deals 48% ATK as DMG to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds. If it passes through an enemy that is Crowd Controlled, it instead deals 80% ATK as DMG.
upgrades.level3: Ice Vortex's each consecutive hit on the same target increases the DMG that target takes from Ice Storm by 12%, stacking up to 15 times.
upgrades.level4: While active, the Ice Vortex deals 60% ATK as DMG to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds. If it passes through an enemy that is Crowd Controlled, it instead deals 100% ATK as DMG.

skills.name: Ring of Blizzard
skills.description: Summon a Blizzard with 3-meter radius in a densely packed area. The blizzard deals 40% ATK as DMG every 0.5 seconds for 3 seconds, then deals 100% ATK as DMG to enemies that remain within the area after 3 seconds.

upgrades.level2: Deals 60% ATK as DMG every 0.5 seconds.
upgrades.level3: Deals 80% ATK as DMG every 0.5 seconds.
upgrades.level4: Enemies that remain within the area after 3 seconds are Frozen for 3 seconds.

skills.name: Ice Prison
skills.description: Freeze the current target for 2 seconds and deal 240% ATK as DMG.

upgrades.level2: Also deals 80% ATK as DMG per second to units around the target.

skills.name: Realm of Frost
skills.description: When an enemy unit is affected by a Crowd Control effect, Skadi summons an Ice Spike to deal 60% ATK as DMG to the target.

relic.name: Iceforged Veins
relic.description: Triggering Realm of Frost grants 8% ATK for 3s. Stacks up to 10 times.

upgrades.level2: When Skadi is about to fall, she freezes herself for 3s, becoming invincible and restoring 20% of her max HP per sec. This can be triggered once per battle.
upgrades.level3: Triggering Realm of Frost grants 12% ATK for 3s. Stacks up to 10 times.
upgrades.level4: Triggering Realm of Frost grants 12% ATK for 8s. Stacks up to 10 times.

pve.label: Standard
pve.description: High strength, can beat all teams. Skadi provides CC while Poseidon and Khepri anchor the front, Pan buffs, and Nuwa sustains the team.

pve.label: Ultimate
pve.description: Mainly targets Dog-head enemies and immortal Treant. Cronus replaces Nuwa for CDR and formation disruption.

coreMechanic.summary: AoE carry with damage scaling by enemy density and built-in lifesteal. Non-overlapping synergies -- slots into any comp. CN: closest non-Celestial DPS to a Celestial.

relicBreakpoints.effect: AoE range and lifesteal meaningful from here.
Carry performance solidified. Core investment target.
